about.title: About Urban Mark Creatives
about.text1: Urban Mark Creatives is a Kenyan design and software studio. We connect creative ideas with reliable technology so companies get a brand, a website and printed materials that look and work as one.
about.text2: Having branding, development and print under one roof means fewer hand-offs, faster delivery and a consistent result. We work remotely with clients across Kenya, Africa, Europe and North America.

values.title: One studio, one standard
values.text: Brand, web and print produced by the same team, so nothing gets lost between suppliers.

values.title: Clear scope, clear price
values.text: You get a written scope and a fixed quote before work starts. No surprise invoices.

values.title: Built to be found
values.text: Every site ships with clean semantic markup, schema, sitemaps and real performance budgets.

values.title: Support that answers
values.text: Direct access to the people who built your project, not a ticket queue.

testimonials.name: Grace Wanjiru
testimonials.quote: Our new booking site cut enquiry handling time in half. The team understood our workflow before writing a single line of code, and the handover documentation was genuinely useful.

testimonials.name: David Otieno
testimonials.quote: We had quotes from three agencies. Urban Mark was the only one that asked about our customers first. The portal they built now handles most of our quotation requests automatically.

testimonials.name: Amina Hassan
testimonials.quote: The packaging redesign got us into two new supermarkets within a quarter. They handled print production end to end, including the press checks I could not attend.

testimonials.name: Peter Mwangi
testimonials.quote: Donor reporting used to take our team a week. The dashboard they built pulls everything together in an afternoon, and it still looks like our brand.

faq.a: We offer branding, web development and print production in one place, so your brand and website stay consistent without juggling several suppliers. You deal with the founders directly.

faq.q: How much does a website cost?
faq.a: Landing pages start from KES 15,000, business websites from KES 25,000 and e-commerce stores from KES 45,000. We send a clear written quote after a short call.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: Landing pages take 1 to 2 weeks. Larger websites and stores usually take 3 to 6 weeks depending on scope, content readiness and feedback speed.
Yes. We accept M-Pesa, bank transfer and card payments, with a deposit to start and the balance on delivery.

faq.q: Do you work with clients outside Kenya?
faq.a: Yes. Most of our work is remote. We work across East Africa, Europe and North America, and we schedule calls in your timezone.
You do. Once the final payment is received, you own the final approved deliverables and all source files.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.body:
This is a starting template. Please have it reviewed for your business before relying on it.

What we collect: the details you send through our contact form (name, phone, email, service and message).

How we use it: only to reply to your enquiry and to provide the services you request. We do not sell your information.

Storage: enquiries are sent to our team by email and kept only as long as we need them.

Your rights: you may ask us to see, correct or delete your information at any time by emailing us.

Cookies: this site uses essential local storage to remember your theme and cookie choice, and analytics pixels only where you have consented.
